cta.title: Would you like to know us better?
cta.text: Call or write to us: we will explain how admission works and arrange a visit to the residence.

home.eyebrow: Care home for the elderly in Maida (CZ), Italy
home.title: Care, attention and a home where you feel welcome
home.intro: We are a social and healthcare residence for older people who are partially or fully dependent, or living with cognitive decline. Every day we combine qualified healthcare with hospitality services designed for well-being.

cards.title: Healthcare
cards.text: Medical and nursing care, rehabilitation and psychological support.

cards.title: Hospitality
cards.text: Personalised menus, laundry service and hairdresser.

cards.title: Social activities
cards.text: Activities and time together to keep interests and relationships alive.

home.qualityText: We work under a UNI EN ISO 9001:2015 quality management system, with HACCP protocols and in compliance with Italian workplace safety law (Legislative Decree 81/2008).

servizi.title: Services
servizi.intro: Complete care, both medical and residential, organised around the needs of each resident.

items.title: Medical care
items.text: Health monitoring under the responsibility of the medical director.

items.title: Nursing care
items.text: Therapies, dressings and daily checks, day and night.

items.title: Rehabilitation
items.text: Physiotherapy programmes to maintain and regain independence.

items.title: Psychological support
items.text: Listening and support for residents and their families.

items.title: Meals
items.text: Menus tailored to individual needs, served at set times.

items.title: Laundry
items.text: Care of residents' linen and clothing.

items.title: Hairdresser
items.text: An in-house service to help residents look and feel their best.

items.title: Social activities
items.text: Group activities and social moments throughout the week.

personale.title: Our staff
personale.intro: A multidisciplinary team working together for the health and peace of mind of our residents.

items.title: Medical director
items.text: Responsible for healthcare organisation and the quality of care.

items.title: Nurses
items.text: Manage therapies, dressings and daily health monitoring.

items.title: Physiotherapists
items.text: Lead rehabilitation and help residents stay mobile.

items.title: Psychologist
items.text: Provides emotional support to residents and guidance to families.

items.title: Educators
items.text: Plan social activities and cognitive stimulation.

items.title: Social worker
items.text: Liaises with families and local services, and handles admission paperwork.

items.title: Care assistants (OSS)
items.text: Support residents in everyday life with care and respect.

qualita.title: Quality
qualita.intro: Quality of care is built on clear rules, regular checks and ongoing training.

items.title: UNI EN ISO 9001:2015
items.text: A quality management system that organises processes, audits and continuous improvement.

items.title: HACCP protocols
items.text: Food safety procedures applied throughout our catering.

items.title: Workplace safety
items.text: Organisation compliant with Legislative Decree 81/2008, protecting residents and staff.

qualita.note: Our Service Charter will soon be available as a PDF on this page.

ammissione.title: Admission
ammissione.intro: There are two ways to be admitted. We are here to guide you through every step.

items.title: Through the local health authority (ASP)
items.text: The application goes through the Provincial Health Authority, which manages the waiting list for subsidised places.

items.title: Directly with the residence (private)
items.text: The application is made directly to us, and we manage the related waiting list.

ammissione.note: Contact us to find out which route suits you best and which documents are needed.
